serviceMatrix.contract: WebWorker construction and execution are absent.
Routes sanitized nonblocking events to MonaLogSink; nil drops them.
Process-memory configuration, default model, editor/diff updates and synchronous change events are retained.
Resource and language override lookup is retained.
files.eol override and macOS LF fallback are retained.
One synthetic inmemory://model/ workspace is retained; no host filesystem workspace is inferred.
file URI uses fsPath semantics; other schemes use URI path; basename behavior is retained.
publicLog2 emits nothing and never reaches MonaLogSink or a network.
Exactly four reachable dialog call sites use the S1-R AppKit dialog outcomes and validity rules.
Standalone fixed flags and MonaCodeEnvironment initialization are retained without browser globals.
info, warn, error and notify route to MonaLogSink only; prompt and status remain strict no-ops with no toast, choice execution or AX output.
Process-global marker ownership, reads and change events are retained.
Language metadata lookup is retained with N1/L2 language-content cuts.
T1 global theme and token behavior is retained.
M1/H2 model registry, creation and lifecycle behavior is retained.
Marker-to-decoration projection and updates are retained.
Process root and per-editor child scopes are retained.
Runs the task and discards progress reports; exposes no progress UI or cancellation control.
show returns inert runner and showWhile only awaits; exposes no editor progress UI.
Four logical scopes are process-memory namespaces only; no disk, defaults, keychain, host storage or cross-process recovery exists.
Open-model text edits, version checks, undo stops and summary are retained; resource edits remain governed by H1.
Workspace trust is always true and never changes.
Only existing registered models resolve; missing resources reject Model not found; references never own model disposal.
A1/A2 AppKit accessibility state and events replace browser media queries and DOM.
Retained widget list identity, selection, focus and lifecycle use AppKit controls.
Component command lookup, will/did order, sync handler invocation and async result normalization are retained.
I3 native event mapping feeds the retained resolver and command semantics.
Retained quick-access data and action traces use native controls.
Overlay ownership, placement and focused-editor fallback use AppKit view/window coordinates.
H1/MD1 link and code-editor opener registries replace window navigation.
I4 NSPasteboard transport and metadata semantics replace browser clipboard APIs.
Retained menu groups, actions, key labels, focus and dismissal use NSMenu.
F1 menu IDs, ordering, context rules and in-session hidden state are retained.
Audio and other accessibility signals emit nothing.
Tree-sitter library loading and tokenization are absent.
No logger resources or output are created.
No data channel is created or opened.
Default account is always null and its change event never fires.
Rename tracking has no external side effect or state.
Retained user-interaction epochs and events follow native input/action commits.

sessionStorage.architecture: MonaSessionStateStore is a process-global MainActor typed store with application, profile, workspace and applicationShared namespaces; it is initialized empty and destroyed with the process.

groups.contract: flags default false; histories are insertion-ordered unique raw strings with no source eviction bound and synchronous store/event effects behind an already-resolved Promise

groups.scope: workspace by default and profile only when shareSuggestSelections=true
groups.contract: default first stores no value; recentlyUsed is LRU 300 with ratio 0.66; prefix serialization keeps 200 newest; save scheduler is 500 ms
two exact code-editor/embedded size identities and one default-false documentation visibility flag
reference Peek layout is restored at creation and stored at close

groups.scope: application for view/offset and profile for command MRU
groups.contract: view position and zero-based default false persist in session; command MRU has default bound 50 and remains process-static because standalone never emits SHUTDOWN
last duration defaults 300000 ms; new-user kind is session state and reset removes it
hidden command state is session-global; the dynamic {submenuID}_lastActionId family has zero concrete registrations because the fixed standalone graph has zero isSplitButton declarations
old-key removal and cache2 restore see an empty store; cache2 save is unreachable because no SHUTDOWN flush caller exists; live CodeLens LRU 20 remains a separate retained cache

sessionStorage.lifetime: Editor disposal does not clear session state. Process termination clears every entry. A new process starts empty. No public storage protocol or persistence opt-in exists in this revision.
sessionStorage.privacy: Find, replace, completion and resource-derived values never leave process memory; logging and generated acceptance artifacts must not serialize session values.

dialogs.architecture: MonaDialogCoordinator presents AppKit sheets owned by the initiating editor window; each result carries dialog, editor, model, version and transaction identity and revalidates before mutation. No host dialog protocol is added.
dialogs.noWindowFallback: Return the non-mutating cancel or false branch and emit one sanitized log event.

callSites.outcomes: Remove executes only after A2 generation and model/version revalidation; Ignore records the existing detector-session ignore state.

callSites.baselineFact: StandaloneDialogService.prompt calls window.confirm and only runs the first prompt button when confirmed; a cancel returns undefined. UndoRedoService treats both first-button value 0 and undefined as UndoChoice.All, so both browser outcomes continue all-files undo.
callSites.outcomes: Both buttons continue the all-files undo path after edit-stack revalidation; Undo this File remains unreachable in the fixed standalone baseline.
Yes re-enters undo with confirmation; No performs no mutation.
Displays localized command label plus error detail; dismissal has no command or model effect.

dialogs.ordering: The sheet result resumes through the repository MainActor microtask queue; the initiating operation continuation runs with the complete validity gate before later results can mutate the same dependency set.
dialogs.focus: Sheet start records first responder; dismissal restores focus only if window, editor, widget generation and responder ownership remain valid.

feedbackChannels.notification: info, warn, error and notify produce sanitized severity-tagged MonaLogSink events only; notification prompt returns inert handle and never executes choices; notification status returns inert close and produces no UI or accessibility announcement.
feedbackChannels.progress: Both progress services execute and await tasks but discard report values and expose no spinner, bar, cancellation button or accessibility announcement.
feedbackChannels.telemetry: All telemetry calls are strict no-ops and never reach a host, file, socket or generated report.
feedbackChannels.accessibilitySignals: playSignal is a strict no-op and no audio resource ships.

acceptance.C04: All 40 default services have exactly one classified native disposition; no unclassified service or added host protocol exists.
acceptance.C05: Cross-editor session state, histories, suggestion selection, quick input, menus, Peek, widget layout and all four dialog outcome traces match S1-R; process restart begins empty.
acceptance.C07: Dialogs expose native roles, labels, focus and deterministic no-window fallback; notification status/prompt, progress and signals produce no accessibility output.
acceptance.C09: Session state remains process-only; bounded states enforce 300/200/50/20 source bounds; find and replace history retain source-unbounded semantic state and are exercised by soak memory accounting.
acceptance.C10: Binary and source scans prove no persistence backend, telemetry transport, notification UI, progress UI, signal audio, WebWorker or Tree-sitter implementation is linked.
acceptance.P11: Provider-result workloads include suggestion memory strategy/scope switching, 500 ms save timing, widget details/size and process-shared state without changing workload IDs.
acceptance.security: Session values never enter logs, crash fixtures, manifests or distribution resources; hostile stored JSON falls back exactly as the fixed consumers define.
